trigger ops.jobs.jobs_delivery_cancelled CREATE TRIGGER jobs_delivery_cancelled AFTER UPDATE OF status ON ops.jobs FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((new.status = 'cancelled'::text) AND (old.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'cancelled'::text) AND (new.kind = ANY (ARRAY['message.send'::text, 'webhook.deliver'::text])))) EXECUTE FUNCTION ops.delivery_job_cancelled()
trigger ops.jobs.jobs_message_dead CREATE TRIGGER jobs_message_dead AFTER UPDATE OF status ON ops.jobs FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((new.status = 'dead'::text) AND (old.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'dead'::text) AND (new.kind = 'message.send'::text))) EXECUTE FUNCTION ops.message_job_dead()
trigger ops.jobs.jobs_reply_unmatched_redact CREATE TRIGGER jobs_reply_unmatched_redact BEFORE UPDATE ON ops.jobs FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((new.kind = 'message.reply_unmatched'::text) AND (new.status <> ALL (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'running'::text])))) EXECUTE FUNCTION ops.redact_reply_unmatched_payload()
trigger ops.jobs.jobs_webhook_dead CREATE TRIGGER jobs_webhook_dead AFTER UPDATE OF status ON ops.jobs FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((new.status = 'dead'::text) AND (old.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'dead'::text) AND (new.kind = 'webhook.deliver'::text))) EXECUTE FUNCTION ops.webhook_job_dead()
